17:76.text: And indeed, they were about to provoke
to evict you therefrom. And then
after you, except for a little.

17:77.text: established way for those We had sent before you of Our messengers; and you will not find in Our way any alteration.

17:78.text: Establish prayer at the decline of the sun
until the darkness of the night
Indeed, the recitation of dawn is ever witnessed.

17:79.text: for you; it is expected that
your Lord will resurrect you to a praised station.

17:80.text: And say, "My Lord, cause me to enter a sound entrance
and to exit a sound exit
and grant me from Yourself a supporting authority."

17:81.text: And say, "Truth has come, and falsehood has departed. Indeed is falsehood,

17:82.text: And We send down of the Qur’ān that which is healing and mercy for the believers, but it does not increase the wrongdoers except in loss.

17:83.text: And when We bestow favor upon man
, he turns away and distances himself; and when evil touches him, he is ever despairing.

17:84.text: Say, "Each works according to his manner, but your Lord is most knowing of who is best guided in way."

17:86.text: And if We willed, We could surely do away with that which We revealed to you. Then you would not find for yourself concerning it an advocate against Us.
